mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, reflecting a restrictive monetary policy stance, increases the cost of capital and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market and robust economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation, measured by a year-over-year CPIAUCSL rate above 3.0%, triggers anticipated monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL YoY rate exceeds 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index, indicating robust manufacturing activity, signals expanding corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth (quarterly) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth exceeding 200,000 new jobs in a month signals a tight labor market and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth exceeding 3.0% year-over-year signals robust economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 YoY growth exceeds 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2,000 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 2000, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.
